tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (29)༄༅/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu las brgyud pa'i zab lam gser chos lnga'i sngon rjes ngag 'don rdo rje'i tshig rkang byin rlabs 'od 'bar zhes bya ba
(29)༄༅/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu las brgyud pa'i zab lam gser chos lnga'i sngon rjes ngag 'don rdo rje'i tshig rkang byin rlabs 'od 'bar zhes bya ba

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (29)༄༅// ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu las brgyud pa'i zab lam gser chos lnga'i sngon rjes ngag 'don rdo rje'i tshig rkang byin rlabs 'od 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(30)༄༅// drug pa'i bdag nyid thabs kyi mchog /shes rab btsun mo ni gup+ta// zung 'jug rin chen brgyud pa yis// byang chub bar du rjes 'dzin mdzod// rdo rje'i gsang tshig baiḍūr+ya// blo gros gyi na'i bzo bcos kyis// ma reg byin rlabs gzi brjid can// gser chos kun la gces 'di'o// dal 'byor thob pa chud mi gsan cing tshe gcig gis rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par 'dod pa'i skal pa can rnams tshul 'di la 'jug par bya'o// de'ang rdo rje'i tshigs rkang las/ dbang bzhis smin byas dad dang brtson 'grus ldan// mi rtag skyo shas nyes dmigs sngon 'gro bas// lam mchog 'di la gang gis 'bad gyur na// zla drug lo'am tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya 'gyur// ces gsungs pa ltar dbang dang byin rlabs rnams kyis rgyud smin cing dad brtson ldan pa gzhir bzhag /nyams len dngos la 'jug pa'i tshe/ thog mar khrid rim spyi dang mthun par blo ldog rnam bzhis rgyud 'khrul ba zhig shin tu gal che bas de gsal gdab pa'i tshig gang rung brjod chog kyang*/ 'dir sa bcad tsam du/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa ni/ /dal brgyad 'byor pa bcu ldan pa// lha las ches lhag mi yi lus// dbul pos nor bu rnyed mtshungs pa// rgyu grangs dpe sogs sgo du mas// da res tsam (31)las rnyed par dka'// 'di yang mi rtag chu bur bzhin// myur du 'jig nges de yi tshe// chos min gzhan gyis spu tsam yang*// phan pa med phyir dam pa'i chos// kun gyi yang snying zab lam bsgom/ /mi rtag pa bsam pa ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten me chus 'jig /nam zla dus bzhi yud tsam 'gyur// thams cad mi rtag mtha' bzhis bcings// skyes nas ma shi gcig kyang med// tshe srog glog dang zil pa 'dra// sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis// sngon la su 'ong nges pa med// dam chos dran tshe ma bsgrubs na// le lo g.yeng ba'i bdud kyis khyer// gcer bu lag stong 'gro dgos pas// dam chos myur du bsgrub par bya/

/las 'bras bsam pa ni/ 'chi tshe 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// mnga' thang yod kyang shul du lus// rang nyid gcig pur bar dor 'khyams// dkar nag las kyi rnam smin ni// lus dang grib ma bzhin tu 'brang*// byas pa'i las rnams chud mi za// ma byas las dang 'phrad mi srid// las rnams 'phel ba 'gyur dang bcas// dge sdig (32)'bras bu bde sdug bsngal// bslu med byed pa po la smin// 'jig rten 'di ni yud tsam ste// 'khor ba mtha' med yun ring bas// da ni rang phung mi bsgrub par// spyi ru las 'bras yid ches shing*// khyad par sdom pa dam tshig bsrung*// rang rgyud nyes pas ma gos bya/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa ni/ /srid rtse mnar med yan chad kyi// 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman kun// me 'obs spu gri'i tshal bzhin tu// bde ba'i go skabs ma mchis na// de snga de tsam 'khor bar 'khyams// ma rig 'khrul 'khor zad pa med// da ni bzod med skyo shas dang*// nges 'byung drag pos rgyud bskul nas// gtan bde thar pa'i lam la zhugs// gong ma'i rnam thar rjes su snyegs// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'thob par bya/ /zhes pa 'di rnams thun mgo thams cad du khrigs chags su 'don dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang skabs su tshig ngag tu brjod// don yid la bsams nas rgyud gnya' rengs su mi btang bar blo dam pa'i chos su 'gro nges par bya ba ni chos nyams su len pa'i rkang dang po yin pas gal che'o// sngon 'gro dngos la gnyis// thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'o// dang po la skyabs sems gnyis las skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bde ba'i stan la lus drang por bsrang*/ sems rnal du phab ste/ zab lam 'di nyid kyi khyad chos skyabs 'gro chig 'dril ma la sgom don gsal 'debs ni/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams chen por gyur// mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad+ma dang*// nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid// sku dngos bkrag mdangs ldan cing gzi brjid 'bar// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun kun 'dus te// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// kun bdag kun 'dus bla ma rin po cher// bdag dang bdag gi tshe 'di'i pha ma dang*// sdang dgra gnod bgegs gnas po gzhi bdag gis// gtsor byas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rigs drug ni// bzod med sdug (33)bsngal drag pos mnar ba kun// khyod las skyabs dang re sa gzhan med pas// ci mdzad khyed shes blo gtad lings bskyur gyis// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos lhan cig tu// skyabs su mchi'o thugs rjes bzung du gsol/

/ces rtse gcig tu mos la/ /ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi ba lags so/ /zhes ci nus brjod/ thun mthar/ mos gus shugs kyis bla ma 'od du zhu// rang thim bla ma rang sems dbyer med gyur/ /ces pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag /sngon 'gro stan gcig ma byed na// bla ma skabs 'dir mi bsdu par 'jog la 'og gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang*/ dag byed stong ra'i gsol gdab zin nas bsdus pas chog go// sems bskyed ni/ nam mkhas gar khyab sems can rnams kyis khyab// kun kyang pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med// re res skye ba dpag med phan pa btags// 'di rnams bde ba 'dod kyang sdug bsngal sgrub// mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje// bdag gis sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las bsgral te// bde ba dam pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// go 'phang mchog la ci nas 'god par bgyi// de yang thabs gzhan cis kyang mi nus pas// tshe 'dir bdag nyid zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang*// thob phyir zab gsang mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi// nye lam brtson 'grus drag pos bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa'i don nan tan tu dran bzhin pas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i phyir du zab lam ni gu'i chos drug nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes dang*/ gser chos phyi ma rnams kyi skabs su/ zab lam phyag rgya chen po// zab lam lam khyer rnam gsum/ zab lam mkha' spyod rnal 'byor/ zab (34)lam 'chi med rang grol/ /ces so sor kha bsgyur ro// zhar byung maṇ+ḍal ni/ bka' srol 'di'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dmigs khrid dkyus su mi ston kyang*// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gzhung rtsa ba zur du phyung ba ma zad/ tshogs myur du rdzogs pa'i thabs su ci nas gal che bas skyabs sems dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs kyi bar mtshams rnams su ci nus 'bul dgos pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung sgros las 'byung bas/

mdun mkhar bla ma gcig rdzogs su gsal gdab// lag len dang 'don bya'i tshig lhug spyi 'gro ltar tshom bu so bdun ma sogs gang bde byas la 'bul tshig shangs pa'i maṇ+ḍal bka' rgya ma ni/ /bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchog /dbus kyi ri rgyal gling bzhi gling phran bcas// gsal byed nyi ma zla bas bskor zhing mdzes// phyi rol lcags ri bar ni rol mtshos brgyan// rin chen dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// rgyal srid sna bdun rin chen gter dang brgyad// ma rmos lo tog yan lag brgyad ldan chu// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin bsam mi khyab// dga' dang spro bar byed pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di// don gnyis sgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas// brtson pa'i stobs kyis bla ma yi dam dang*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi// sangs rgyas kun gyi gdung 'dzin rnal 'byor pas// mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun byang nas// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ces grangs la nges pa med pas ci nus su 'bul lo// gnyis pa thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gro la gnyis// dag byed a'i stong ra dang*/ byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni/ rang gi spyi bor bzhi rdzogs gdan gyi steng*// dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma sku dngos gsal/ mos gus gdung shugs drag tu bskyed la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi nad (35)gdon thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ /ces gsol ba dos drag la yun ring du btab pa'i mthar/ bla ma 'od zhu rang gi spyi bo nas// zhugs thim rkyen gyis mgo bo'i gdos bcas sbyangs// dkar gsal srab dwangs dbus su chos 'byung dkar// rtsa ba phra ba mgrin pa'i mtshams su sleb// gdengs ka gyen bstan zur gcig smin phrag dang*// zur gnyis rna ba g.yas g.yon thad du reg

/dwangs gsal shel snod lta bu'i kha mtshams dbus// bla ma rang sems dbyer med a dkar 'tsher// skye med spros bral don la sems bzung zhing*// bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis bdud rtsi shugs drag babs// phyi nang kun khengs sdig sgrib nyams chags dang*// nang gdon bar chad sha khrag dngos po bcas// dud khu rnag khrag srog chags rnam par bkrus// 'od lus dwangs gsal bdud rtsis khengs par gyur/ /zhes gsal btab/ thog mar chos 'byung a yig dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin/ de nas a thung gi bzlas pa nyer gcig mthar bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gi dmigs pa gsal la drag par byas te lus dag pa'i dmigs pa grub rjes cung zad re ngal gsos la shes pa klod/ slar dmigs pa bsgom pa lan grangs brgya stong khri 'bum bskyar/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mgor re res chog go// gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor chos drug so sor bsgyur kha yod pa las/ dang po gtum mo'i skabs su sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos dang*/ rjes srid pa'i dbang zhu ba gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po ni/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad dkar dang*// nyi zla'i gdan la bla ma sangs rgyas ni// ston zla ltar dkar zhal 'dzum bde nyams rgyas// rang la byin gyis rlobs bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ /ces gsal btab la mos gus bskyed de/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che (36)sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi lus la bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sems la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab/ bla ma bdud rtsi'i ngo bor 'od du zhu// rang thim rnam smin phung po 'ja' ltar yal// ye shes lha yi sku gsung thugs su gyur/ /ces mos te stong ra sgom pa la 'jug go// gnyis pa rjes gtum mo bsgoms pa'i mjug thun mtshams la 'jug ka thams cad bya dgos pa ni/

spyi bor seng khri pad dkar nyi zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dkar gsal 'od zer 'phro// skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bor bzhugs pa la// nyer spyod rnam bdun khang bzang bzhugs khri dang*// na bza' dpag bsam ljon shing rin chen gter// 'dod 'jo'i pha mo rgyal srid rnam pa bdun// bkra shis rdzas rtags thogs pa'i lha mo sogs// phyogs dus kun gyi mchod rdzas bzang dgu dang*// sha lnga bdud rtsi'i ye shes bdud rtsi'i dngos// zag med bde chen skyed byed rigs kyi yum// kun kyang snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa// sgyu ma lta bur shes pas mchod par bgyi/ /zhes gsal gdab la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che la/ phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab la/ gsol btab thugs dam rgyud bskul bla ma yi// sku las zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun// dkar dwangs bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa babs// spyi bo nas zhugs smin mtshams yan chad gang*// bum pa'i dbang thob sku yi dngos grub stsol// slar yang babs pas mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob (37)gsung gi dngos grub stsol// slar yang babs pas snying ga yan chad gang*// sher ye'i dbang thob thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun lte ba sogs nas brgyud// rkang mthil yan chad lus kyi nang kun gang*// bzhi pa'i dbang thob gsang gsum dngos grub stsol// bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim pa yis// bla ma'i gsang gsum rang gi sgo gsum po// dbyer med chu la chu bzhag lta bur gyur/ /ces mnyam par bzhag /gnyis pa sgyu lus phyin chad kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dmigs pa'i rkang gcig la bsgyur kha phran pa yod/

gsol 'debs kyang rtsa ba gcig pa la gsham so sor bsgyur pa yin te/ de la thog mar sgyu lus skabs/ mdun mkhar seng khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang*// nyi zla'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// bkrag mdangs gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par bzhugs// thugs las 'od 'phros brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam zhi khro phyogs dus rdzogs sangs rgyas// lung rtogs dam chos 'phags pa'i dge 'dun tshogs// mkha' 'gro chos srung thams cad spyan drangs thim// dkon mchog kun 'dus blo gtad gcig chog gyur// mtshan thos 'khor ba ngan song las sgrol na// gsol ba btab na lta yang ci smos pas// bdag dang pha ma dgra bgegs gzhi bdag gis// gtsor byas mkha' mnyam 'gro drug sems can kun// sgo gsum rtse gcig gus pas gsol 'debs shing*// 'byung bzhi'i rdul phran las kyang gsol 'debs kyi// rang sgra 'ur 'ur dir dir sgrog par gyur/ /ces dmigs la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol// dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol// sgyu lus 'byongs par mdzad du gsol// rmi lam 'byongs (38)par mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du// myur ba nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces ngar drag yun ring snang ba 'gyur ngos su gsol ba btab la/ mthar/ /bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur// thugs yid dbyer med ma bcos lhug par bzhag /ces mnyam par bzhag nas sgyu lus kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom mo// rmi lam la/ dmigs pa sngar dang 'dra/ gsol 'debs tshigs rkang dang po gsum gzhir bzhag nas/ mtha' bskyur pa phyin chad thams cad la rigs 'gre dgos pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/

sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ ces pa'i mthar// rmi lam thog mar bzung ba'i skabs/ rmi lam zin par mdzad du gsol/ ces sbyar/ zin nas sbyong skabs/ rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ ces dang*/ spel skabs/ rmi lam spel nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces dang*/ sgyur skabs/ rmi lam bsgyur nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yul snang skabs/ yul snang gtan la phebs par mdzad du gsol/

ces bsgyur/ 'od gsal bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/ dmigs pa dang po'i tshig rkang gnyis pa/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ dbu skra thor tshugs rus pa'i rgyan drug spras// stag lpags smad dkris dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs// bkrag mdangs gzi brjid sogs dang*/ gsol 'debs tshig rkang gsum pa'i gsham/ 'od gsal zin par mdzad du gsol/ ces spyan/ 'pho ba dang bar do gnyis la dmigs pa sgyu lus skabs de kas chog /gsol 'debs gsham/ bar dor 'tshang rgya bar mdzad du gsol/ ces dang*/ bar dor longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces rim bzhin sbyar ro// gser chos lhag ma gsum la'ang*// gong smos dag byed a'i stong ra yan chad spyi mthun yin pas song na (39)legs/ skyabs sems gnyis ni thams cad la med thabs med cing*/ de mtshams bla ma'i rnal 'byor dgos pa gong gsal sgyu lus kyi skabs dang mthun pa las/ gsol 'debs gsham/ phyag chen la/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ ces sbyar/ lam khyer gsum gyi dang po bla ma lam khyer la/ ci snang bla mar 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ gnyis pa yi dam lam khyer la/ ci snang yi dam du 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa sgyu ma lam khyer gyi snang ba sgyu ma lam khyer la/ snang ba rang sems su rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam sgyu ma lam khyer la/ ci snang sgyu ma rmi lam du 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sbyang*/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar la yig rnying las 'byung ba'i khyad 'phags gsol 'debs sogs gzhan du shes dgos la/ 'chi med 'chug med la/ sems 'chi med rang grol du rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ ces sbyar ba'o// skabs su rtsa brgyud bla ma'i gsol 'debs brgyud pa gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa ci rigs spro zhing nus na bya/ mi nus na 'dir bstan pa rnams ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thems yig gis bsdams shing khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang nas grub thob chen po kho na'i zhal sgo brgyud pa/

so skye'i blos bzo bcos dang spros pa'i bsre bslad med pas byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che ba yin pa yid ches shing chog shes par byas la 'di kho na tshig tu brjod cing don bsam/ gtso bor kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin pa'i mos gus drag pos gsol 'debs kyi skad gdangs che chung ring thung ci bder rang gi nyams dang sbyar te snang ba gtad med du sgyur nus pa zhig gal che/ rtsa ba'i chos bzhi stan thog gcig tu sgom pa'i skabs/ bla ma sgom tshul dang gsol 'debs kyi gzhi tshig rkang gsum po sngar sgyu lus skabs dang 'dra ba las/ mtha' sgyur/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byor sa par mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod/ de ltar bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di rnams dngos gzhi'i nyams rtogs skyed byed la gal shin tu che bas/ khrid srol gzhan pa ltar yun ring thung ci (40)rigs par gud du phye nas thun bcad grub na ches legs pas de'i tshe thun mthar tshar gsum khug pa'i dbang len dgos pa dang*/ sgyu lus sogs dngos gzhi'i sgom don dang sbrel yang*/ de ltar bya ba grub chen thang rgyal gyi khrid las gsungs pas lhag skyon med la/ gang ltar dbang len dgos pa'i tshe/ gsol 'debs kyi mthar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po ches/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu/ bdag la ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur du gsol/ /ces gsol ba lan gsum btab/ bla ma'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gsal ba yi// dpral ba'i oṃ las oṃ dang 'od dkar 'phros// rang gi dpral bar thim pas bum dbang thob// lus sgrib dag nas bskyed rim bsgom la dbang*// sprul sku'i sa bon thebs shing rtogs pa skyes// mgrin pa'i āḥlas āḥyig 'od dmar 'phros// rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsang dbang thob// ngag sgrib dag nas rang byin brlab la dbang*// longs sku'i sa bon thebs shing rtogs pa skyes// thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ dang 'od sngon 'phros// rang gi snying gar thim pas sher dbang thob// yid sgrib dag nas pho nya'i lam la dbang*// chos sku'i sa bon thebs nas rtogs pa skyes// bla ma 'od zhu rang dang dbyer med 'dres// bzhi pa'i dbang thob snyoms 'jug sgrib pa dag

/zung 'jug bsam mi khyab pa bsgom la dbang*// sku bzhi'i rtogs pa mngon tu byas par gyur/ /ces mos la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag /thun mtshams rnams su bar/ /pha bla ma/ pha bla ma/ pha bla ma rang mkhyen/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes mos gus snying la 'brab pa re byas nas de'i ngang la lhod kyis glod la ngang bskyang ba gal che'o// thams cad kyi rjes kyi bya ba smon lam/ bkra shis/ bsngo ba gsum du gsungs pa'i (41)gsum ka'ang ye shes mkha' 'gro nyid kyi rdo rje'i gsung byin rlabs kyi gzi byin dang ldan pa bka' rgya mar grags pa rnams 'grub na mchog yin kyang*/ nyams len dngos la dril ba'i skabs 'don bya mang po mi lcog na mdor bsdus tsam du smon lam ni/ kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan// bdag gi dge ba 'dir thob ste// 'gro kun gyis kyang thob par shog /rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas nas gang spyod pa// byang chub rdo rjes bsngags pa yi// spyod pa de gnyis bdag spyod shog /bkra shis ni/ legs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs pa// bla ma yi dam bkra shis shog /phrin las thams cad sgrub mdzad pa// mkha' 'gro chos skyong bkra shis shog /bsngo ba ni/ /dge ba'i tshogs rnams bsags pa kun// bdag gir yongs su bzung med par// sems can ma lus kun don du// chos dbyings bla na med par bsngo/ /zhes pa tsam byas te spyod lam la 'jug go// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi thams cad kyi skabs su shin tu gal che ba/ sangs rgyas gnyan ston chen po'i zhal nas/ gnad rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni// snying rjes kun la bslangs pa'i sems kyis byams pa phan sems bskyed pa dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa drag po rgyun chad med par bsams pas blo sna thung spung song ste cis kyang dgos med rgyud la bskyed pa dang*/

bla ma la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas/ mos gus thun mong ma yin pa skyes te/ mchi ma rang dbang med pa'i mos gus rgyun chad med pa gsum gyis sgyu ma rang shar/ snang ba thams cad bden med du 'gro ba dang*/ rmi lam rang zin dang*/ spyod spel sprul bsgyur dang*/ yul snang gtan la pheb pa dang*/ nyin par phyag rgya chen po gsal la rtog med du 'char ba dang*/ mtshan mo lha sku rang shar dang*/ 'od gsal phyogs med du 'char ba rnams ji lta bzhin 'byung bar (42)'gyur ro// gong gi chos gsum po de rgyud la ma skyes na/ brtson 'grus chen pos yun ring nyams su blangs kyang mthar thug gi 'bras bu 'byung bar dka' bas// chos gsum po de la nan gyis rtse gcig tu nyams su blangs pa 'di gal che'o// zhes sogs kyis snying rje/ mi rtag pa/ mos gus gsum po rgyud la 'bral med du skye ba zhig ma byung thabs med pa'i tshul rgyu mtshan bcas nan tu gdams par mdzad pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ zhal gdams spyi gnad 'di ltar nyams su blang*// phan sems snying rjes gzhan don phyogs med 'byung*// gsol ba btab na nyams rtogs phyog med 'char// 'dun pa rtse gcig rmi lam myur du 'byongs// bsnyen sgrub byas na dngos grub phyogs med thob// dam tshig bsrungs na mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du// dgos med skyes na longs spyod char bzhin 'bab// phrag dog spangs na mtho dman kun gyis 'khur// bdag 'dzin spangs na gegs kyis tshugs mi srid// rgyun gtor brtson na bar chad rang sar 'dag /'dzin pa spangs na gol sar lhung mi 'gyur// bshags pa byas na sdig pa thams cad 'dags// bsod nams bsags na dge sbyor shugs la 'char// rtsol bcas byas na rtsol med ngang gis 'char// dug lnga skyes tshad 'dzin med grol bar 'gyur// snang ba mi 'gag lam khyer sangs rgyas thob// re med yengs med lo zlas byang chub 'grub// mos gus tshad med gzhan snang zil gyis gnon// dmigs med bsngo bas bsod rnams dpag med 'phel// re dogs spangs na 'bras bu myur du thob// thugs la zhog la nyams su long mdzod dang*// ring por mi thogs 'bras bu 'grub par 'gyur// ces gdams par mdzad pa dang*/

gsung sgros thor bu mas/ skye ba 'di phyi thams cad kyi bsod nams zad par byed pa dang*/ sangs rgya ba'i gegs log lta yin pas dag snang sbyang*/ gdams ngag dang dngos grub kyi gegs the tshom yin pas nges shes bskyed/ grub pa myur du mi 'thob pa'i gegs bla ma yi dam dang*/ gdams ngag sna tshogs yin pas gang la nges shes thob pa gcig la nyams len bya// sgrib (43)gnyis myur du mi byang pa'i gegs byar med yin pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang rtsol bcas kyi dge sbyor la 'bad// ye shes kyi tshogs myur du mi rdzogs pa'i gegs bden zhen yin pas/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma rmi lam du shes par bya/ gzhan don gyi gegs rang don yin pas phan sems smon lam la 'bad pa gal che bar gsungs pa nyams len mkhan po rnams kyis snying gi ze'u 'brur bcangs pa gal che bar snang ngo*// yang zab snying po'i 'don sgom 'di// sngon 'gror grags kyang dngos gzhi'i mthil// skal bzang skye bo bye snyed kyis// 'dir 'bad zung 'jug mchog brnyes shog /ces rje bla ma thams cad mkhyen gzigs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos ring nas gnang ba stsal ba dang*/ yang khrod 'dir bzhugs sgrub bla snga rjes rnams dang*/ khyad par gter chen bsam gtan gling pa'i bstan pa'i snang byed 'phel tshe rig 'dzin bla ma mgon po rdo rjes bkra shis pa'i lha reg bcas ched du bskul ma mdzad dor/ ris med kyi bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /(44)
